note: DeepSeek released R1 with open weights Jan 20, 2025 ($0.55/$2.19); the Jan 27 market reaction (incl. ~17% NVDA drop) made it the H1 story.
GPT-4.5 shipped as a research preview Feb 27, 2025 (priced $75/$150; later deprecated in favor of GPT-4.1).
GPT-5 did not ship by June 15, 2025 (it shipped August 2025); Feb 2025 roadmap said 'months away'.
Anthropic shipped Claude Opus 4 and Sonnet 4 on May 22, 2025.
Gemini 2.5 Pro (March 2025) led major coding/reasoning leaderboards; Gemini 2.0 family went GA Feb 2025.
OpenAI shipped o3-mini Jan 31, 2025 and full o3 (with o4-mini) April 16, 2025.
Prices kept falling: GPT-4.1 at $2/$8 (April 2025), o3 cut ~80% to $2/$8 (June 10, 2025), DeepSeek R1 pressure on reasoning pricing.
xAI shipped Grok 3 Feb 17, 2025, trained on the Colossus cluster; API followed in April.
Meta released Llama 4 Scout and Maverick with open weights April 5, 2025.
Frontier-lab valuations jumped: Anthropic $3.5B at $61.5B (March 2025); OpenAI $40B at $300B (March 2025).
MCP became the cross-vendor standard: OpenAI adopted it March 2025, Google DeepMind April 2025.
No frontier LLM developer (OpenAI, Anthropic, xAI, Mistral) completed an IPO by June 15, 2025.
